responsibility: This definition module declares Logitech-compatible scalar floating-point utility routines for GNU Modula-2. It defines helpers for extracting fractional and integer parts, rounding, truncation, and integer-to-real conversion for both REAL and LONGREAL values, forming a small arithmetic support layer rather than a formatted I/O or string-conversion module.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the FloatingUtilities pair: it lists the REAL and LONGREAL helper routines exported to clients, while FloatingUtilities.mod provides their arithmetic implementations.
